title: OpenMAP-HIE: Pathology Informed Score-based Diffusion Model for Unsupervised Neonatal Hypoxic-Ischemic Encephalopathy Lesion Segmentation
title_zh: OpenMAP-HIE：面向无监督新生儿缺氧缺血性脑病病灶分割的病理感知分数扩散模型

paragraphs.en: Accurate localization of neonatal hypoxic–ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) lesions on apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) images is clinically important but is limited by scarce expert annotations and substantial variation in lesion appearance. We propose OpenMAP-HIE, a pathology-informed score-based diffusion model for unsupervised HIE lesion localization without voxel-wise lesion supervision. A denoising diffusion model learns the healthy neonatal ADC distribution, while a ControlNet-based conditional branch preserves patient-specific anatomy. At inference, anomaly evidence is derived directly from differences between conditional and unconditioned noise predictions at independently evaluated diffusion noise levels, avoiding dependence on a final pseudo-healthy reconstruction or sequential reverse-diffusion chain. Based on the characteristic ADC reduction associated with acute HIE, only discrepancies consistent with the expected pathological direction are retained and aggregated across noise levels using a geometric mean. Spatial mean filtering further suppresses isolated responses. The framework was evaluated on the BONBID-HIE dataset. The ADC-only method achieved a Dice score of 0.283 ± 0.244 0.283\pm 0.244 , average precision of 0.505 0.505 , Hausdorff distance of 25.45 ± 15.63 25.45\pm 15.63 mm, mean average surface distance of 9.40 ± 8.49 9.40\pm 8.49 mm, and normalized surface distance of 0.355 ± 0.236 0.355\pm 0.236 , providing the best overlap and surface-distance performance among the evaluated unsupervised methods and Dice performance comparable to supervised ADC-only models. Optional population-derived ADC Z Z -map refinement further increased Dice to 0.602 ± 0.269 0.602\pm 0.269 . These findings support pathology-informed score discrepancies as a useful signal for neonatal HIE lesion localization, while highlighting remaining challenges in detecting small and low-contrast lesions.
paragraphs.zh: 在表观扩散系数（ADC）图像上准确定位新生儿缺氧缺血性脑病（HIE）病灶具有重要的临床价值，但受限于专家标注稀缺以及病灶表现差异巨大。 我们提出 OpenMAP-HIE，一种病理信息引导的基于得分的扩散模型，可在无体素级病灶监督的情况下实现无监督的 HIE 病灶定位。 一个去噪扩散模型学习健康新生儿 ADC 分布，同时一个基于 ControlNet 的条件分支保留患者特异的解剖结构。 在推理阶段，异常证据直接来自条件预测与无条件预测在独立评估的各扩散噪声水平上的噪声预测差异，从而避免依赖最终的伪健康重建或顺序反向扩散链。 基于急性 HIE 特征性的 ADC 降低，仅保留与预期病理方向一致的不一致之处，并使用几何平均在多个噪声水平上进行聚合。 空间均值滤波进一步抑制了孤立的响应。 该框架在 BONBID-HIE 数据集上进行了评估。 仅使用 ADC 的方法取得了 0.283 ± 0.244 0.283\pm 0.244 的 Dice 分数、0.505 0.505 的平均精度、25.45 ± 15.63 25.45\pm 15.63 mm 的 Hausdorff 距离、9.40 ± 8.49 9.40\pm 8.49 mm 的平均表面距离，以及 0.355 ± 0.236 0.355\pm 0.236 的归一化表面距离，在所评估的无监督方法中提供了最佳的重叠和表面距离性能，其 Dice 性能与有监督的仅 ADC 模型相当。 可选的基于人群的 ADC Z Z -map 精化进一步将 Dice 提升至 0.602 ± 0.269 0.602\pm 0.269 。 这些发现支持将病理信息引导的得分差异作为新生儿 HIE 病灶定位的有效信号，同时也凸显了在小病灶和低对比度病灶检测方面仍存在的挑战。

paragraphs.en: Hypoxic ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) is a clinical syndrome of neurological disorder caused by impaired cerebral oxygen delivery and blood flow around the time of birth. It affects approximately 1–5 per 1,000 term-born neonates ( Long and Brandon, 2007 ) . Therapeutic hypothermia reduces the risk of death and disability in infants with moderate-to-severe HIE ( Silveira and Procianoy, 2015 ) . However, mortality and adverse long-term outcomes, including neurodevelopmental delay and cognitive or motor impairment, still affect approximately 30 % 30\% – 50 % 50\% of affected infants ( Bao et al., 2025 ) . Accurate identification and localization of HIE-related brain injury are therefore important for quantitatively characterizing lesion severity and for understanding disease progression ( Vermeulen et al., 2008 ; Martinez-Biarge et al., 2011 ; Chang et al., 2020 ; Bobba et al., 2023 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 缺氧缺血性脑病（HIE）是一种由于出生前后脑部氧供和血流受损而导致的神经系统功能障碍的临床综合征。 其发病率约为每1000名足月新生儿中有1–5例（Long and Brandon, 2007）。 亚低温治疗可降低中重度HIE患儿的死亡和致残风险（Silveira and Procianoy, 2015）。 然而，死亡率和不良长期结局，包括神经发育迟缓以及认知或运动障碍，仍影响约30% 30\%–50% 50\%的患病婴儿（Bao et al., 2025）。 因此，准确识别和定位HIE相关的脑损伤对于定量刻画病变严重程度和理解疾病进展十分重要（Vermeulen et al., 2008; Martinez-Biarge et al., 2011; Chang et al., 2020; Bobba et al., 2023）。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) has been applied for detecting acute HIE-related injury, because abnormalities may appear earlier and more observable than signal changes on conventional T1- or T2-weighted MRI ( Triulzi et al., 2006 ; Bano et al., 2017 ) . Cytotoxic edema restricts water diffusion, typically producing increased signal intensity on DWI and decreased apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) values ( Onda et al., 2024 ) . ADC maps thus provide quantitative information for identifying HIE-related injury and assessing its severity and prognosis ( Bobba et al., 2023 ; Bao et al., 2025 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 弥散加权成像（DWI）已被应用于检测急性HIE相关损伤，因为其异常表现可能比常规T1或T2加权MRI上的信号变化出现得更早且更易观察（Triulzi et al., 2006；Bano et al., 2017）。 细胞毒性水肿限制水的弥散，通常在DWI上表现为信号强度增高，并伴有表观弥散系数（ADC）值降低（Onda et al., 2024）。 因此，ADC图可为识别HIE相关损伤以及评估其严重程度和预后提供定量信息（Bobba et al., 2023；Bao et al., 2025）。

sents.zh: 因此，ADC图可为识别HIE相关损伤以及评估其严重程度和预后提供定量信息（Bobba et al., 2023；Bao et al., 2025）。

paragraphs.en: Automated localization remains challenging because HIE lesions are often small, multifocal, diffuse, and heterogeneous in appearance. In the BONBID-HIE cohort, more than half of affected neonates had lesions occupying less than 1 % 1\% of the brain volume ( Bao et al., 2025 ) , resulting in severe foreground–background imbalance and poorly defined lesion boundaries. Scanner field strength, acquisition protocol, developmental anatomy, and postnatal imaging time further complicate the distinction between pathology and normal neonatal variability. These characteristics also make manual delineation difficult. Quantitative lesion analysis typically requires experienced pediatric neuroradiologists, often using multi-reader consensus ( Bao et al., 2025 ) , but lesion boundaries may remain ambiguous and dependent on reader judgment. Consequently, expert voxel-level annotation is labor intensive and difficult to scale.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化病灶定位仍然具有挑战性，因为 HIE 病灶通常较小、多灶、弥漫且外观异质。 在 BONBID-HIE 队列中，超过一半的受累新生儿的病灶占脑容量的比例不足 1 % 1\% （Bao et al., 2025），这导致了严重的Foreground–Background前景–背景不平衡以及模糊的病灶边界。 扫描仪场强、采集方案、发育解剖学以及出生后成像时间进一步增加了病理与正常新生儿变异之间区分的难度。 这些特征也使得人工勾画变得困难。 定量病灶分析通常需要经验丰富的儿科神经放射科医师，且往往采用多阅片者共识（Bao et al., 2025），但病灶边界可能仍然模糊并依赖于阅片者的判断。 因此，专家级别的体素级标注非常耗费人力且难以规模化。

sents.zh: 自动化病灶定位仍然具有挑战性，因为 HIE 病灶通常较小、多灶、弥漫且外观异质。

sents.zh: 这些特征也使得人工勾画变得困难。

sents.zh: 因此，专家级别的体素级标注非常耗费人力且难以规模化。

paragraphs.en: Supervised deep-learning approaches have achieved encouraging performance for neonatal HIE lesion segmentation ( Bao et al., 2025 ; Rao et al., 2025 ; Almansour et al., 2025 ) . However, the scarcity of publicly available neonatal HIE data ( Bao et al., 2025 ) , along with the substantial expertise and effort required for annotation, restricts the scalability and external generalizability of these methods. Unsupervised anomaly detection provides an alternative by learning a normative representation from healthy images and identifying deviations in a potentially pathological subject without directly optimizing on lesion labels ( Schlegl et al., 2019 ; Fernando et al., 2021 ) . A common strategy is to reconstruct a pseudo-healthy counterpart of the observed image and interpret the reconstruction residual as abnormality ( Schlegl et al., 2019 ; Wolleb et al., 2022 ; Wyatt et al., 2022 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 有监督深度学习方法在新生儿缺氧缺血性脑病（HIE）病灶分割方面已取得令人鼓舞的性能（Bao et al., 2025; Rao et al., 2025; Almansour et al., 2025）。 然而，公开可用的新生儿HIE数据的稀缺（Bao et al., 2025），以及标注所需的大量专业知识和精力，限制了这些方法的可扩展性和外部泛化能力。 无监督异常检测提供了一种替代方案，它从健康图像中学习规范表征，并在可能存在病变的受检者中识别偏离，而无需直接基于病灶标签进行优化（Schlegl et al., 2019; Fernando et al., 2021）。 一种常见策略是重建观测图像的伪健康对应图像，并将重建残差解释为异常（Schlegl et al., 2019; Wolleb et al., 2022; Wyatt et al., 2022）。

sents.en: Supervised deep-learning approaches have achieved encouraging performance for neonatal HIE lesion segmentation ( Bao et al., 2025 ; Rao et al., 2025 ; Almansour et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 有监督深度学习方法在新生儿缺氧缺血性脑病（HIE）病灶分割方面已取得令人鼓舞的性能（Bao et al., 2025; Rao et al., 2025; Almansour et al., 2025）。

sents.en: However, the scarcity of publicly available neonatal HIE data ( Bao et al., 2025 ) , along with the substantial expertise and effort required for annotation, restricts the scalability and external generalizability of these methods.
sents.zh: 然而，公开可用的新生儿HIE数据的稀缺（Bao et al., 2025），以及标注所需的大量专业知识和精力，限制了这些方法的可扩展性和外部泛化能力。

sents.en: Unsupervised anomaly detection provides an alternative by learning a normative representation from healthy images and identifying deviations in a potentially pathological subject without directly optimizing on lesion labels ( Schlegl et al., 2019 ; Fernando et al., 2021 ) .
sents.zh: 无监督异常检测提供了一种替代方案，它从健康图像中学习规范表征，并在可能存在病变的受检者中识别偏离，而无需直接基于病灶标签进行优化（Schlegl et al., 2019; Fernando et al., 2021）。

sents.en: A common strategy is to reconstruct a pseudo-healthy counterpart of the observed image and interpret the reconstruction residual as abnormality ( Schlegl et al., 2019 ; Wolleb et al., 2022 ; Wyatt et al., 2022 ) .
sents.zh: 一种常见策略是重建观测图像的伪健康对应图像，并将重建残差解释为异常（Schlegl et al., 2019; Wolleb et al., 2022; Wyatt et al., 2022）。

paragraphs.en: However, reconstruction-based anomaly detection must balance pathology removal against preservation of healthy subject-specific anatomy. Excessive corruption or insufficient conditioning may alter normal structures and generate false-positive residuals, whereas strong subject conditioning may reproduce pathological signals and reduce lesion contrast. This trade-off is particularly problematic for HIE because diffusion abnormalities may be subtle, spatially diffuse, and poorly separated from normal neonatal variability ( Forbes et al., 2000 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 然而，基于重建的异常检测必须在去除病理与保留受试者特异的健康解剖结构之间取得平衡。 过度的破坏或不足的条件约束可能改变正常结构并产生假阳性残差，而过强的受试者条件约束则可能复现病理信号并降低病灶对比度。 这种权衡对缺氧缺血性脑病（HIE）尤为棘手，因为弥散异常可能十分轻微、空间上弥散，且难以与正常的新生儿变异区分开来 ( Forbes et al., 2000 ) 。

sents.en: However, reconstruction-based anomaly detection must balance pathology removal against preservation of healthy subject-specific anatomy.
sents.zh: 然而，基于重建的异常检测必须在去除病理与保留受试者特异的健康解剖结构之间取得平衡。

sents.zh: 这种权衡对缺氧缺血性脑病（HIE）尤为棘手，因为弥散异常可能十分轻微、空间上弥散，且难以与正常的新生儿变异区分开来 ( Forbes et al., 2000 ) 。

paragraphs.en: Diffusion models have recently emerged as expressive generative priors for unsupervised medical anomaly detection ( Wolleb et al., 2022 ; Wyatt et al., 2022 ; Frotscher et al., 2026 ) . Their multi noise level denoising process provides an opportunity to identify deviations from learned normal anatomy other than the residual of a single final reconstruction. However, reliably distinguishing subtle pathological signals from subject-specific anatomy, acquisition-related variability, and stochastic denoising errors remains challenging.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散模型近来已成为无监督医学异常检测中富有表现力的生成先验（Wolleb et al., 2022；Wyatt et al., 2022；Frotscher et al., 2026）。 其多噪声水平去噪过程提供了超越单一最终重建残差的方式来识别与所学正常解剖结构的偏差。 然而，如何可靠地将细微病理信号与受试者特异性解剖结构、采集相关的变异以及随机去噪误差区分开来，仍然具有挑战性。

sents.en: Diffusion models have recently emerged as expressive generative priors for unsupervised medical anomaly detection ( Wolleb et al., 2022 ; Wyatt et al., 2022 ; Frotscher et al., 2026 ) .
sents.zh: 扩散模型近来已成为无监督医学异常检测中富有表现力的生成先验（Wolleb et al., 2022；Wyatt et al., 2022；Frotscher et al., 2026）。

sents.en: However, reliably distinguishing subtle pathological signals from subject-specific anatomy, acquisition-related variability, and stochastic denoising errors remains challenging.
sents.zh: 然而，如何可靠地将细微病理信号与受试者特异性解剖结构、采集相关的变异以及随机去噪误差区分开来，仍然具有挑战性。

paragraphs.en: In this work, we propose OpenMAP-HIE, an anatomy-conditioned, pathology-informed score-based diffusion framework for unsupervised neonatal HIE lesion localization (Fig. 1 ). A diffusion model learns a healthy neonatal ADC prior, and a ControlNet branch incorporates the observed image as a spatial condition to capture patient-specific anatomy. We derive anomaly evidence from discrepancies between the healthy-prior and subject-conditioned score estimates, implemented through their noise-prediction differences (Fig. 2 ). These discrepancies characterize how subject-specific conditioning modifies the local denoising response of the learned healthy prior. Both branches evaluate the same noisy input at each noise level, with inputs generated directly from the observed image rather than propagated through a sequential reverse-diffusion chain. This formulation avoids dependence on a final pseudo-healthy reconstruction and the propagation of errors between reverse-diffusion steps.
paragraphs.zh: 在本工作中，我们提出 OpenMAP-HIE，这是一种以解剖结构为条件、由病理信息引导的基于分数的扩散框架，用于无监督的新生儿缺氧缺血性脑病（HIE）病灶定位（图 1）。 扩散模型学习健康新生儿的表观扩散系数（ADC）先验，而一个 ControlNet 分支将观测图像作为空间条件纳入，以捕捉患者特异的解剖结构。 我们从健康先验与受试者条件下的分数估计之间的差异中推导异常证据，并通过二者的噪声预测差异来实现（图 2）。 这些差异刻画了受试者特异性条件如何修改所学健康先验的局部去噪响应。 两个分支在每个噪声水平下评估同一含噪输入，其输入直接由观测图像生成，而非通过顺序反向扩散链逐步传播得到。 这种构造避免了依赖最终的伪健康重建以及反向扩散步骤之间的误差传播。

paragraphs.en: To improve pathological specificity, we incorporate a directional prior based on the characteristic ADC reduction associated with acute HIE ( Forbes et al., 2000 ; Bobba et al., 2023 ; Bao et al., 2025 ) . Specifically, we retain discrepancies whose corresponding denoising estimates indicate a higher ADC under the healthy prior than under subject conditioning, and suppress discrepancies in the opposite direction. The retained responses are aggregated across independently evaluated noise levels using a geometric mean to emphasize directionally consistent evidence. Population-derived ADC Z Z -maps ( Bao et al., 2025 ; Rao et al., 2025 ) are additionally investigated as an optional refinement, while the core framework requires only the subject’s ADC image at inference.
paragraphs.zh: 为提高病理特异性，我们引入一种方向先验，其依据是急性缺氧缺血性脑病（HIE）所伴随的 ADC 特征性降低（Forbes et al., 2000; Bobba et al., 2023; Bao et al., 2025）。 具体而言，我们保留那些对应的去噪估计显示健康先验下 ADC 高于受试者条件化下 ADC 的差异，并抑制方向相反的差异。 保留的响应在独立评估的多个噪声水平上通过几何平均进行聚合，以强调方向一致的证据。 基于群体的 ADC Z Z 图（Bao et al., 2025; Rao et al., 2025）被进一步研究作为一种可选的改进，而核心框架在推理时仅需要受试者的 ADC 图像。

paragraphs.en: The principal contributions of this work are:
paragraphs.zh: 本文的主要贡献如下：

paragraphs.en: We introduce an anatomy-conditioned diffusion framework that contrasts healthy-prior and subject-conditioned responses without using lesion masks as optimization targets.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种以解剖学为条件的扩散框架，该框架对比健康先验响应与受试者条件响应，而无需将病灶掩膜作为优化目标。

paragraphs.en: We formulate anomaly evidence through conditional–unconditional score discrepancies, implemented as noise-prediction differences and aggregated across independently evaluated noise levels, without requiring a sequential reverse-diffusion chain or a final pseudo-healthy reconstruction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过条件–无条件分数差异来构建异常证据，将其实现为噪声预测差异，并在独立评估的噪声水平上进行聚合，而无需顺序的反向扩散链或最终的伪健康重建。

paragraphs.en: We incorporate an HIE-specific directional prior that retains score discrepancies consistent with the expected ADC reduction of acute injury, adding pathology informed directionality to the score-based anomaly representation.
paragraphs.zh: 我们引入了一种针对 HIE 的方向先验，该先验保留与急性损伤预期 ADC 降低相一致的分数差异，为基于分数的异常表示增加了病理信息的方向性。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate the framework on the public BONBID-HIE benchmark using voxel-ranking, lesion-overlap, and surface-distance metrics, and further assess population-derived ADC Z Z -map refinement as an optional extension.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在公开的 BONBID-HIE 基准上，采用体素排序、病灶重叠和表面距离等指标对该框架进行评估，并进一步将基于人群的 ADC Z Z 图精修作为可选扩展加以评估。

paragraphs.en: The proposed ADC-only method achieved improved lesion overlap and surface localization relative to the evaluated unsupervised baselines, while the pathology-informed directional constraint provided substantial gains in lesion localization. Population-derived Z Z -map refinement further improved overlap and boundary accuracy when population-level normative information was available. The code of this work is available at github.com/OishiLab/OpenMAP-HIE .
paragraphs.zh: 所提出的仅用ADC的方法相较于所评估的无监督基线方法取得了更好的病灶重叠度和表面定位效果，而基于病理信息的方向性约束在病灶定位方面带来了显著提升。 当可获得群体水平的常模信息时，基于群体的 Z Z 图细化进一步提高了重叠度和边界准确性。 本工作的代码可在 github.com/OishiLab/OpenMAP-HIE 获取。

paragraphs.en: Supervised medical image segmentation has advanced through encoder–decoder architectures such as U-Net ( Ronneberger et al., 2015 ) and UNet++ ( Zhou et al., 2019 ; Rao et al., 2025 ) . Recent HIE segmentation systems have extended to three-dimensional U-Net variants, SegResNet, Swin-UNETR ( Hatamizadeh et al., 2021 ; Almansour et al., 2025 ) , ensembles, and loss functions designed for highly imbalanced lesions ( Bao et al., 2025 ) . These approaches learn lesion appearance directly from voxel-wise annotations. In contrast, our framework learns a healthy-image prior and derives lesion evidence without using lesion masks as optimization targets.
paragraphs.zh: 监督式医学图像分割已通过诸如 U-Net（Ronneberger 等，2015）和 UNet++（Zhou 等，2019；Rao 等，2025）等编码器–解码器架构取得了进展。 近期的 HIE 分割系统已扩展到三维 U-Net 变体、SegResNet、Swin-UNETR（Hatamizadeh 等，2021；Almansour 等，2025）、集成方法，以及为高度不平衡病灶设计的损失函数（Bao 等，2025）。 这些方法直接从体素级标注中学习病灶外观。 相比之下，我们的框架学习健康图像先验，并在不将病灶掩码作为优化目标的情况下推导病灶证据。

paragraphs.en: Reconstruction-based anomaly detection learns normal image appearance and identifies abnormalities through discrepancies between an input and its reconstructed counterpart. Autoencoders and variational autoencoders learn constrained representations of healthy images ( Baur et al., 2021 ) , while f-AnoGAN combines a GAN-based normal-image model with an encoder for efficient latent inference ( Schlegl et al., 2019 ) . Denoising autoencoders instead learn to recover healthy images from artificially corrupted inputs, where appropriately designed coarse noise can improve anomaly detection while preserving normal anatomical detail ( Kascenas et al., 2022 ) . IterMask 2 combines iterative spatial mask refinement with high-frequency image information to improve reconstruction of normal tissue and reduce false-positive responses ( Liang et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 基于重建的异常检测学习正常图像的外观，并通过输入图像与其重建图像之间的差异来识别异常。 自编码器和变分自编码器学习健康图像的受限表示（Baur et al., 2021），而 f-AnoGAN 将基于 GAN 的正常图像模型与编码器相结合，以实现高效的潜在空间推断（Schlegl et al., 2019）。 去噪自编码器则学习从人工损坏的输入中恢复健康图像，其中经过恰当设计的粗噪声可以在保留正常解剖细节的同时改进异常检测（Kascenas et al., 2022）。 IterMask 2 将迭代空间掩码细化与高频图像信息相结合，以改进正常组织的重建并减少假阳性响应（Liang et al., 2024）。

paragraphs.en: These methods depend on reconstruction errors being larger in pathological regions than in healthy regions. However, normal anatomy may be reconstructed imperfectly, while sufficiently expressive models may partially reproduce pathological structures. Consequently, reconstruction fidelity alone does not guarantee pathological specificity.
paragraphs.zh: 这些方法依赖于一个假设，即病理区域的重建误差会大于健康区域的重建误差。 然而，正常解剖结构可能无法被完美重建，而表达能力足够强的模型也可能部分重现病理结构。 因此，仅凭重建保真度并不能保证对病理的特异性。

paragraphs.en: Denoising diffusion probabilistic models (DDPMs) learn a data distribution by progressively perturbing images with noise and training a neural network to predict the noise of removal for the reverse process ( Ho et al., 2020 ) . Under the standard Gaussian perturbation formulation, noise prediction provides a parameterization of the score, the gradient of the perturbed data log density with respect to the noisy input ( Song et al., 2021 ) . This connection enables anomaly assessment through both reconstructed images and noise-level dependent noise predictions. Further, compared with GANs, diffusion models generally offer stable training and high-fidelity outputs ( Dhariwal and Nichol, 2021 ) , making them suitable for learning healthy anatomical priors.
paragraphs.zh: 去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）通过逐步对图像添加噪声进行扰动，并训练神经网络预测反向过程中需要去除的噪声，从而学习数据分布（Ho et al., 2020）。 在标准高斯扰动公式下，噪声预测提供了得分（score）的一种参数化，即扰动后数据对数密度关于带噪输入的梯度（Song et al., 2021）。 这种联系使得可以通过重建图像和依赖于噪声水平的噪声预测来进行异常评估。 此外，与生成对抗网络（GAN）相比，扩散模型通常具有训练稳定和输出高保真的优点（Dhariwal and Nichol, 2021），因此适合用于学习健康解剖先验。

paragraphs.en: Early diffusion-based methods primarily used pseudo-healthy reconstruction. AnoDDPM uses structured Simplex noise to obscure abnormalities at lower diffusion noise levels while retaining more image context ( Wyatt et al., 2022 ) . Wolleb et al. ( 2022 ) combined deterministic Denoising Diffusion Implicit Model (DDIM) inversion ( Song et al., 2020 ) with classifier guidance ( Dhariwal and Nichol, 2021 ) to generate counterfactual healthy images. Patched diffusion models restrict corruption to local image regions and use surrounding anatomy as contextual information for denoising process, with pseudo-healthy reconstruction based on ensembles of predictions through sliding-window procedure ( Behrendt et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 早期的基于扩散的方法主要采用伪健康图像重建。 AnoDDPM 使用结构化 Simplex 噪声在较低的扩散噪声水平下遮蔽异常，同时保留更多图像上下文（Wyatt et al., 2022）。Wolleb 等人 （2022）将确定性的去噪扩散隐式模型（DDIM）反演（Song et al., 2020）与分类器引导（Dhariwal and Nichol, 2021）相结合，以生成反事实的健康图像。 分块扩散模型将破坏限制在局部图像区域，并利用周围解剖结构作为去噪过程的上下文信息，通过滑动窗口程序基于预测集合进行伪健康图像重建（Behrendt et al., 2024）。

sents.en: Early diffusion-based methods primarily used pseudo-healthy reconstruction.
sents.zh: 早期的基于扩散的方法主要采用伪健康图像重建。

paragraphs.en: Subsequent methods have attempted to restrict restoration to suspected pathological regions to avoid unnecessary modification of healthy anatomy. AutoDDPM first generates an anomaly-likelihood map and then uses masking, stitching, and joint-noise resampling to inpaint candidate abnormalities while harmonizing the reconstructed content with the original image ( Bercea et al., 2023 ) . Temporal Harmonization for Optimal Restoration (THOR) instead constructs intermediate anomaly maps during reverse diffusion and uses them as implicit guidance to repeatedly restore presumed healthy regions from the original input ( Bercea et al., 2024 ) . These methods are conceptually related to diffusion-based inpainting approaches such as RePaint ( Lugmayr et al., 2022 ) , in which known image regions are repeatedly reintroduced during sampling to constrain the generated result.
paragraphs.zh: 后续方法试图将修复限制在疑似病理区域内，以避免对健康解剖结构进行不必要的修改。 AutoDDPM 首先生成异常似然图，然后利用掩码、拼接和联合噪声重采样对候选异常进行修复，同时使重建内容与原始图像保持协调（ Bercea et al., 2023 ）。 Temporal Harmonization for Optimal Restoration（THOR）则改为在反向扩散过程中构建中间异常图，并将其作为隐式引导，从原始输入反复修复假定的健康区域（ Bercea et al., 2024 ）。 这些方法在概念上与 RePaint（ Lugmayr et al., 2022 ）等基于扩散的修复方法相关，后者在采样过程中反复重新引入已知图像区域，以约束生成结果。

sents.en: Subsequent methods have attempted to restrict restoration to suspected pathological regions to avoid unnecessary modification of healthy anatomy.
sents.zh: 后续方法试图将修复限制在疑似病理区域内，以避免对健康解剖结构进行不必要的修改。

sents.en: AutoDDPM first generates an anomaly-likelihood map and then uses masking, stitching, and joint-noise resampling to inpaint candidate abnormalities while harmonizing the reconstructed content with the original image ( Bercea et al., 2023 ) .
sents.zh: AutoDDPM 首先生成异常似然图，然后利用掩码、拼接和联合噪声重采样对候选异常进行修复，同时使重建内容与原始图像保持协调（ Bercea et al., 2023 ）。

sents.en: Temporal Harmonization for Optimal Restoration (THOR) instead constructs intermediate anomaly maps during reverse diffusion and uses them as implicit guidance to repeatedly restore presumed healthy regions from the original input ( Bercea et al., 2024 ) .
sents.zh: Temporal Harmonization for Optimal Restoration（THOR）则改为在反向扩散过程中构建中间异常图，并将其作为隐式引导，从原始输入反复修复假定的健康区域（ Bercea et al., 2024 ）。

sents.en: These methods are conceptually related to diffusion-based inpainting approaches such as RePaint ( Lugmayr et al., 2022 ) , in which known image regions are repeatedly reintroduced during sampling to constrain the generated result.
sents.zh: 这些方法在概念上与 RePaint（ Lugmayr et al., 2022 ）等基于扩散的修复方法相关，后者在采样过程中反复重新引入已知图像区域，以约束生成结果。

paragraphs.en: Masking and local restoration have also been explored in latent diffusion frameworks, with introducing localized latent-space corruptions during training as proxies for anomalous regions. MAD-AD applies forward diffusion only to randomly selected patches of healthy latent representations during training and jointly learns to reconstruct the clean latent representation and predict the region of corruption. At inference, its mask-prediction head identifies candidate anomalous patches, which are exclusively corrected during reverse diffusion while the remaining regions are preserved ( Beizaee et al., 2025b ) . DeCo-Diff reformulates latent diffusion to learn a direction of deviation from normality. It progressively corrects anomalous latent patches while leaving normal patches unchanged and combines reconstruction discrepancies measured in the latent and image spaces to produce the final anomaly map ( Beizaee et al., 2025a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 掩码与局部修复方法也已在潜在扩散框架中得到探索，方法是在训练过程中引入局部化的潜在空间破坏，作为异常区域的替代物。 MAD-AD 在训练时仅对随机选取的健康潜在表示块施加前向扩散，并联合学习重建干净的潜在表示和预测被破坏的区域。 在推理阶段，其掩码预测头识别出候选异常块，这些块在反向扩散过程中被专门修正，而其余区域保持不变（Beizaee et al., 2025b）。 DeCo-Diff 重新构造了潜在扩散，使其学习一个偏离正常状态的方向。 它逐步修正异常的潜在块同时保持正常块不变，并结合在潜在空间和图像空间中测得的重建差异来生成最终的异常图（Beizaee et al., 2025a）。

paragraphs.en: Rather than producing a final pseudo-healthy reconstruction or iteratively refining a candidate inpainting mask, Aggregated Normative Diffusion (ANDi) derives anomaly evidence directly from deviations within the diffusion process ( Frotscher et al., 2026 ) . At each noise level, ANDi compares the analytical reverse-posterior mean conditioned on the observed image with the reverse mean predicted by the diffusion model, both evaluated at the same noisy input. The resulting voxel-wise squared differences are aggregated across noise levels using a geometric mean. The voxel-wise squared deviations are aggregated across multiple sampled noise levels using a geometric mean. Consequently, ANDi does not require an additional inpainting stage or calculate its anomaly map only from a final reconstruction residual. Extending this reconstruction-free direction, InvAD instead uses DDIM inversion ( Song et al., 2020 ) to map image representations toward the noise prior and evaluates deviations through Gaussian likelihood scoring in the resulting final latent space ( Sakai et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 聚合规范扩散（ANDi）并非生成最终的伪健康重建或迭代地优化候选修复掩码，而是直接从扩散过程内部的偏差中获取异常证据（Frotscher et al., 2026）。 在每个噪声水平上，ANDi 将以观测图像为条件的解析反向后验均值与扩散模型预测的反向均值进行比较，两者均在同一含噪输入上计算。 由此得到的体素级平方差异使用几何均值在多个噪声水平上进行聚合。 体素级平方偏差使用几何均值在多个采样的噪声水平上进行聚合。 因此，ANDi 不需要额外的修复阶段，也不仅根据最终重建残差来计算其异常图。 延续这一免重建的方向，InvAD 改为使用 DDIM 反演（Song et al., 2020）将图像表示映射至噪声先验，并在由此得到的最终潜空间中通过高斯似然评分来评估偏差（Sakai et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Our approach is most closely related to ANDi in its aggregation of discrepancies across noise levels. The key distinction is the comparison itself: we contrast subject-conditioned and learned healthy-prior score estimates, implemented through their noise-prediction differences, rather than comparing a model prediction with an analytical posterior target. We further filter the discrepancy signals using directional information from an HIE-specific pathological prior.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法与 ANDi 最为接近之处在于其跨噪声水平聚合差异的方式。 关键区别在于比较本身：我们对比的是以受试者为条件学到的健康先验分数估计，通过其噪声预测差异来实现，而不是将模型预测与解析后验目标进行比较。 我们进一步利用来自 HIE 特异性病理先验的方向性信息对差异信号进行过滤。

paragraphs.en: Most reconstruction-based medical anomaly detection methods define abnormity from the difference between an observed image and a pseudo-healthy reconstruction, commonly using absolute or squared intensity residuals ( Schlegl et al., 2019 ; Wolleb et al., 2022 ; Wyatt et al., 2022 ) . More recent diffusion-based approaches characterize abnormality through deviations from learned normal denoising dynamics ( Bercea et al., 2024 ; Frotscher et al., 2026 ; Beizaee et al., 2025b ) or gaussian prior likelihood ( Sakai et al., 2026 ) . These disease-agnostic formulations are applicable to diverse anomaly types, but generally treat positive and negative intensity deviations symmetrically. Consequently, a large anomaly score does not have strong pathological interpretability and cannot properly distinguish the target pathology from the anatomical variance and imaging noise.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数基于重建的医学异常检测方法通过观测图像与伪健康重建图像之间的差异来定义异常，通常采用绝对或平方的强度残差（Schlegl 等，2019；Wolleb 等，2022；Wyatt 等，2022）。 较新的基于扩散的方法则通过偏离学习到的正常去噪动力学（Bercea 等，2024；Frotscher 等，2026；Beizaee 等，2025b）或高斯先验似然（Sakai 等，2026）来刻画异常。 这些与疾病无关的公式化定义可适用于多种异常类型，但通常对正负强度偏差作对称处理。 因此，较大的异常分数并不具备较强的病理学可解释性，也无法将目标病理与解剖变异和成像噪声正确区分开来。

paragraphs.en: This limitation is particularly relevant to neonatal HIE. During the acute diffusion-restriction phase, cytotoxic edema typically produces lower ADC values in injured tissue than in healthy tissue ( Forbes et al., 2000 ; Bobba et al., 2023 ; Onda et al., 2024 ; Bao et al., 2025 ) . ADC thresholds and population-derived statistical maps have therefore been investigated for identifying and quantifying HIE-related injury ( Bao et al., 2025 ) . However, the diffusion-based anomaly detection methods considered above do not explicitly incorporate the expected direction of the ADC abnormality into their multi noise-level discrepancy estimation. Our method incorporates this pathological information by retaining only positive differences between subject-conditioned and healthy-prior unconditional noise predictions, corresponding to higher healthy-reference posterior than subject-conditioned reverse-mean estimates. Unlike a conventional unsigned reconstruction residual, this formulation suppresses denoising discrepancies that are large in magnitude but inconsistent with the characteristic ADC reduction of acute HIE.
paragraphs.zh: 这一局限性对新生儿缺氧缺血性脑病（HIE）尤为相关。 在急性扩散受限期，细胞毒性水肿通常使受损组织的ADC值低于健康组织（Forbes et al., 2000；Bobba et al., 2023；Onda et al., 2024；Bao et al., 2025）。 因此，研究者探索了ADC阈值和基于人群的统计图谱来识别和量化HIE相关损伤（Bao et al., 2025）。 然而，上文考虑的基于扩散的异常检测方法在其多噪声级差异估计中并未显式纳入ADC异常的预期方向。 我们的方法通过仅保留受试者条件下与健康先验无条件噪声预测之间的正差值来纳入这一病理信息，其对应于高于受试者条件的反向均值估计的健康参考后验。 与传统的无符号重建残差不同，该表述可抑制幅值较大但与急性HIE特征性ADC降低不一致的去噪差异。

paragraphs.en: The directional constraint improves pathological relevance but does not by itself establish lesion specificity. Normal anatomical variation, partial-volume effects, registration differences, acquisition-related intensity variation, and imaging artifacts may also produce positive discrepancies. The resulting score is therefore interpreted as evidence of a persistent deviation from the learned healthy denoising behavior that is directionally consistent with acute HIE-related ADC reduction, rather than as a calibrated lesion probability.
paragraphs.zh: 方向性约束提升了病理相关性，但其本身并不能确立病灶特异性。 正常解剖变异、部分容积效应、配准差异、采集相关的强度变化以及成像伪影也可能产生正向偏差。 因此，所得分数被解释为偏离所学到的健康去噪行为的持续性偏差的证据，且该偏差方向上与急性缺氧缺血性脑病（HIE）相关的ADC降低一致，而不是被解释为经过校准的病灶概率。

paragraphs.en: The diffusion-derived anomaly map characterizes subject-specific disagreement between the conditional and unconditional noise predictions. Although this discrepancy provides complementary evidence of abnormal tissue, it may also respond to normal anatomical variation, tissue boundaries, registration errors, and acquisition-related artifacts. We therefore combine the diffusion anomaly score with a population-normalized ADC Z Z -map ( Bao et al., 2025 ) , which provides an independent spatial measure of deviation from the healthy reference population. Because acute HIE lesions are generally associated with restricted diffusion and reduced ADC values ( Onda et al., 2024 ) , strongly negative Z Z -scores provide biologically consistent evidence for lesion localization ( Bao et al., 2025 ; Rao et al., 2025 ) .

paragraphs.en: We used the BONBID-HIE dataset ( Bao et al., 2025 ) for model development and evaluation. The dataset was divided into 85 training subjects, 4 validation subjects, and 44 test subjects, as following its predefined partitions, without performing an additional subject-level split and with no subject overlap among the three partitions. All 133 subjects in the selected release were included, with no subject-level exclusions. Each subject included an three-dimensional ADC map and its corresponding population-normalized Z Z -map. To account for variations in voxel spacing and spatial misalignment across scans, all volumes were affine registered to the JHU-neonate-SS atlas template ( Oishi et al., 2011 ) using ANTsPy ( Tustison et al., 2021 ) . At the end, all scans were resampled to a common matrix size 256 × 256 × 128 256\times 256\times 128 and voxel size 0.58 × 0.58 × 0.74 0.58\times 0.58\times 0.74 m ​ m 3 mm^{3} , with nearest neighbor interpolation, as following Rao et al. (2025) . The intensity of each volume went through its independent 99th percentile normalization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 BONBID-HIE 数据集（Bao et al., 2025）进行模型开发与评估。 该数据集按照其预定义的划分被分为 85 个训练受试者、4 个验证受试者和 44 个测试受试者，未进行额外的受试者级别划分，且三个划分之间没有受试者重叠。 所选发布版本中的全部 133 个受试者均被纳入，没有任何受试者级别的排除。 每个受试者包含一幅三维 ADC 图及其对应的总体归一化 Z Z -图。 为了处理不同扫描之间体素间距的差异和空间错位问题，所有体积均使用 ANTsPy（Tustison et al., 2021）仿射配准到 JHU-neonate-SS 图集模板（Oishi et al., 2011）。 最后，参照 Rao et al. (2025)，所有扫描均通过最近邻插值重采样到统一的矩阵尺寸 256 × 256 × 128 256\times 256\times 128 和体素尺寸 0.58 × 0.58 × 0.74 0.58\times 0.58\times 0.74 m ​ m 3 mm^{3}。 每个体积的强度都经过各自独立的第 99 百分位数归一化。

paragraphs.en: The diffusion model was trained using two-dimensional axial ADC slices. To construct a training set representing non-lesion brain tissue, we examined the corresponding lesion mask for each slice from the training subjects and retained only slices containing no annotated lesion voxels. The lesion masks were used exclusively for training-slice selection and were not provided to the model as inputs or optimization targets. The Z Z -maps were not used to train the diffusion model and were introduced only during the post-processing stage described in Section 3.6 . We have 6042 slices of non-lesion axial brain slices for training and 4838 slices of lesion axial brain slices from the training subjects for the hyperparameter selection for the post-processing stage.
paragraphs.zh: 扩散模型使用二维轴位ADC切片进行训练。 为了构建代表非病灶脑组织的训练集，我们检查了训练受试者每个切片对应的病灶掩膜，仅保留不含标注病灶体素的切片。 病灶掩膜仅用于训练切片的筛选，并未作为输入或优化目标提供给模型。 Z Z-图并未用于训练扩散模型，仅在3.6节所述的后处理阶段才被引入。 我们有6042个非病灶轴位脑切片用于训练，以及来自训练受试者的4838个病灶轴位脑切片，用于后处理阶段的超参数选择。

As following Zhang et al. (2023) , at each resolution level, the features produced by the ControlNet encoder were projected through a zero-initialized convolution and injected into the corresponding feature stream of the primary U-Net through a residual connection. paragraphs.en: where 𝐡 ℓ UNet \mathbf{h}_{\ell}^{\mathrm{UNet}} and 𝐡 ℓ Control \mathbf{h}_{\ell}^{\mathrm{Control}} denote the primary U-Net and ControlNet feature maps, respectively, and 𝒵 ℓ \mathcal{Z}_{\ell} denotes the zero-initialized convolutional projection. paragraphs.en: Both training stages were optimized using AdamW ( Loshchilov and Hutter, 2017 ) with a batch size of 8. We employed a warm-up cosine-decay learning-rate schedule. During the first 5 % 5\% of the total optimization steps, the learning rate was increased from 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} to the target learning rate of 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} . It was subsequently decayed according to a cosine schedule over the remaining optimization steps. An exponential moving average of the model parameters was maintained with a decay rate of 0.995 0.995 .
paragraphs.zh: 两个训练阶段均使用 AdamW（Loshchilov and Hutter, 2017）进行优化，批次大小为 8。 我们采用了带预热的余弦衰减学习率调度。 在总优化步数的前 5% 5\% 内，学习率从 2 × 10 − 5 2\times 10^{-5} 增加到 1 × 10 − 4 1\times 10^{-4} 的目标学习率。 随后在剩余的优化步数中按照余弦调度进行衰减。 模型参数以 0.995 0.995 的衰减率维护指数移动平均。

paragraphs.en: In the first stage, the U-Net diffusion model was trained for K 1 = 300 K_{1}=300 epochs to learn the healthy neonatal image distribution. In the second stage, the pretrained U-Net served as the healthy generative prior, and the ControlNet branch was trained for an additional K 2 = 200 K_{2}=200 epochs to incorporate subject-specific spatial conditioning. To enable both null-conditioned and subject-conditioned noise predictions, the conditioning image was randomly dropped with probability p drop = 0.1 p_{\mathrm{drop}}=0.1 during ControlNet training.
paragraphs.zh: 在第一阶段，U-Net 扩散模型经过 K 1 = 300 K_{1}=300 个 epoch 的训练，以学习健康新生儿图像的分布。 在第二阶段，预训练的 U-Net 作为健康生成先验，ControlNet 分支额外训练了 K 2 = 200 K_{2}=200 个 epoch，以纳入受试者特异的空间条件控制。 为了同时支持无条件和受试者条件下的噪声预测，在 ControlNet 训练过程中，条件图像以 p drop = 0.1 p_{\mathrm{drop}}=0.1 的概率被随机丢弃。

paragraphs.en: During inference, following the intermediate-noise strategy described in ( Frotscher et al., 2026 ) , we accumulated the conditional-unconditional discrepancy over diffusion timesteps 𝒯 = { 75 , 76 , … , 199 } . \mathcal{T}=\{75,76,\ldots,199\}. This interval was selected to balance corruption of the pathological signal with preservation of subject-specific anatomy. At very low noise levels, the lesion appearance remains largely preserved in 𝐱 t \mathbf{x}_{t} , providing insufficient perturbation for the healthy prior to reveal a clear discrepancy. Conversely, at substantially higher noise levels, excessive corruption removes subject-specific anatomical information and may introduce reconstruction differences unrelated to pathology. The selected intermediate timesteps weaken the lesion-related signal while retaining sufficient anatomical information for spatially meaningful comparison between the conditional and unconditional noise predictions.
paragraphs.zh: 在推理阶段，遵循 (Frotscher et al., 2026) 中描述的中间噪声策略，我们在扩散时间步 𝒯 = {75, 76, …, 199} \mathcal{T}=\{75,76,\ldots,199\} 上累积条件-无条件差异。 选择该区间是为了在破坏病理信号与保留受试者特异性解剖结构之间取得平衡。 在极低的噪声水平下，病灶外观在 𝐱 t \mathbf{x}_{t} 中基本保持不变，无法提供足够的扰动使健康先验呈现出明显的差异。 相反，在显著更高的噪声水平下，过度破坏会去除受试者特异性的解剖信息，并可能引入与病理无关的重建差异。 所选的中间时间步削弱了与病灶相关的信号，同时保留了足够的解剖信息，以便在条件与无条件噪声预测之间进行具有空间意义的比较。

paragraphs.en: We evaluated the predicted anomaly maps using complementary voxel-ranking, volumetric-overlap, and surface-distance metrics. paragraphs.en: Statistical comparisons were performed using two-sided paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests, with each test subject serving as the paired unit. paragraphs.en: Table 1 compares the proposed method with existing state-of-the-arts unsupervised anomaly detection approaches. The compared approaches were trained over the same training subjects and used their original proposed post-processing smooth methods. Among the evaluated baselines, f-AnoGAN ( Schlegl et al., 2019 ) failed to converge reliably and AnoDDPM ( Wyatt et al., 2022 ) remained unstable when trained with Simplex noise. Therefore, quantitative results are not reported for these two methods.
paragraphs.zh: 表1将所提出的方法与现有的最先进无监督异常检测方法进行了比较。 所比较的方法均在相同的训练受试者上进行训练，并使用其原始提出的后处理平滑方法。 在评估的基线方法中，f-AnoGAN（Schlegl 等，2019）未能可靠收敛，而 AnoDDPM（Wyatt 等，2022）在使用单纯形噪声训练时仍不稳定。 因此，这两种方法未报告定量结果。

paragraphs.en: Without spatial filtering, our method achieved a Dice score of 0.232 0.232 , significantly exceeding the best-performing converged baselines, MAD-AD ( Beizaee et al., 2025b ) with Dice 0.166 0.166 ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 , n = 44 n=44 ). It also obtained an NSD of 0.284 0.284 , compared with the best baseline MAD-AD’s NSD of 0.213 0.213 . The corresponding HD and MASD were 29.29 29.29 mm and 12.62 12.62 mm, respectively, representing the second-best performance for both distance-based metrics after MAD-AD. The unfiltered anomaly map achieved an AP of 0.374, which was lower than those of DAE (0.665) and MAD-AD (0.492), but higher than the remaining diffusion-based and feature-based baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 在不使用空间滤波的情况下，我们的方法取得了 0.232 0.232 的 Dice 分数，显著优于表现最好的已收敛基线方法 MAD-AD（Beizaee et al., 2025b）的 Dice 0.166 0.166（p < 0.001 p<0.001，n = 44 n=44）。 它还取得了 0.284 0.284 的 NSD，而最佳基线方法 MAD-AD 的 NSD 为 0.213 0.213。 相应的 HD 和 MASD 分别为 29.29 29.29 mm 和 12.62 12.62 mm，在这两项基于距离的指标上均取得了仅次于 MAD-AD 的第二佳性能。 未滤波的异常图取得了 0.374 的 AP，低于 DAE（0.665）和 MAD-AD（0.492），但高于其余基于扩散和基于特征的基线方法。

paragraphs.en: Applying mean filtering with a kernel size of k = 5 k=5 consistently improved the proposed method across all reported metrics. Dice significantly increased from 0.232 0.232 to 0.283 0.283 (absolute gain of 0.051 0.051 ; p = 0.001 p=0.001 , n = 44 n=44 ). paragraphs.en: Relative to MAD-AD, the strongest competing baseline for spatial localization, the mean-filtered model significantly improved Dice by 0.117 ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 , n = 44 n=44 ), reduced HD by 1.99 mm, reduced MASD by 1.93 mm, and increased NSD by 0.142. Although DAE ( Kascenas et al., 2022 ) achieved the highest AP of 0.665, its Dice 0.159 0.159 and NSD 0.176 0.176 were substantially lower than those of our proposed mean-filtered method. Overall, these findings indicate that the proposed approach provides more accurate lesion overlap and boundary localization, while DAE retains an advantage in global voxel-ranking performance.
paragraphs.zh: 相对于在空间定位方面最强的竞争基线 MAD-AD，均值滤波模型将 Dice 显著提升了 0.117（p < 0.001 p<0.001，n = 44 n=44），将 HD 降低了 1.99 mm，将 MASD 降低了 1.93 mm，并将 NSD 提高了 0.142。 尽管 DAE（Kascenas et al., 2022）取得了最高的 AP 0.665，但其 Dice 0.159 0.159 和 NSD 0.176 0.176 远低于我们所提出的均值滤波方法。 总体而言，这些结果表明所提出的方法能够提供更精确的病灶重叠和边界定位，而 DAE 在全局体素排序性能方面仍保持优势。

paragraphs.en: To assess the effect of lesion burden on detection performance, we further stratified the test subjects according to their ground-truth lesion percentage into small ( < 1 % <1\% ), medium ( 1 % 1\% – 5 % 5\% ), and large ( ≥ 5 % \geq 5\% ) lesion-burden groups, as following Rao et al. (2025) in Table 2 . Before mean filtering, performance improved consistently with increasing lesion burden: Dice increased from 0.080 0.080 for the small-lesion group to 0.287 0.287 and 0.603 0.603 for the medium- and large-lesion groups, respectively. Correspondingly, HD decreased from 40.27 40.27 mm to 26.39 26.39 mm and 10.23 10.23 mm, while NSD increased from 0.155 0.155 to 0.388 0.388 and 0.640 0.640 .

paragraphs.en: Fig. 3 compares anomaly maps from selected top-performing baselines with those produced by our method in subjects with different lesion burdens. In the illustrated cases, DAE ( Kascenas et al., 2022 ) produces spatially extensive responses beyond the annotated lesions, whereas ANDi ( Frotscher et al., 2026 ) exhibits scattered responses with limited separation between lesion and non-lesion tissue. MAD-AD ( Beizaee et al., 2025b ) produces more localized responses but also highlights regions outside the lesion annotations, particularly in the small-lesion example. Our method shows closer spatial correspondence with the annotated lesions in the medium- and large-burden examples, although scattered responses remain outside the lesion boundaries. Mean filtering reduces isolated responses and produces smoother anomaly maps while preserving the lesion associated responses. The small-lesion example remains challenging, where the lesion is detected but is less noticeable with surrounding false positive responses. Some apparent false positive responses occur in regions with relatively low ADC values or interhemispheric asymmetry in ADC intensity, indicating that the directional constraint does not fully suppress responses outside the annotated lesions.
paragraphs.zh: 图3比较了所选表现最佳的基线方法与我们的方法在不同病灶负荷受试者上产生的异常图。 在所示的病例中，DAE（Kascenas et al., 2022）在标注病灶之外产生了空间范围广泛的响应，而ANDi（Frotscher et al., 2026）表现出分散的响应，病灶与非病灶组织之间的区分有限。 MAD-AD（Beizaee et al., 2025b）产生的响应更为局部化，但也高亮了病灶标注之外的区域，尤其是在小病灶示例中。 在中等和大病灶负荷示例中，我们的方法与标注病灶在空间上更为吻合，尽管在病灶边界之外仍存在分散的响应。 均值滤波减少了孤立的响应，在保留病灶相关响应的同时产生了更平滑的异常图。 小病灶示例仍然具有挑战性，虽然病灶被检测到，但由于周围存在假阳性响应，病灶不太显眼。 一些明显的假阳性响应出现在ADC值相对较低或ADC强度存在半球间不对称的区域，这表明方向性约束并不能完全抑制标注病灶之外的响应。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 compares the proposed unsupervised anomaly detection method with supervised Swin-UNETR ( Almansour et al., 2025 ) and UNet++ ( Rao et al., 2025 ) segmentation models under matched ADC-only and population Z Z -map enhanced settings, which are the top performed models from the BONBID-HIE challenge ( Bao et al., 2025 ) . In the ADC-only setting (the gray-shaded rows in Table 3 ), our method achieved a Dice score of 0.232 0.232 , which was comparable to the supervised UNet++ model of 0.237 0.237 , and an NSD of 0.284 0.284 , approaching the UNet++ NSD of 0.298 0.298 . Swin-UNETR achieved highest ADC-only Dice and NSD values of 0.311 0.311 and 0.406 0.406 , respectively.

paragraphs.en: Despite the comparable overlap with UNet++, the ADC-only anomaly detection model remained less competitive in voxel-ranking and boundary-distance performance. It achieved an AP of 0.374, compared with 0.645 for Swin-UNETR and 0.803 for UNet++. Similarly, its HD of 29.29 29.29 mm and MASD of 12.62 12.62 mm were higher than those of both supervised models. These findings show that the proposed method can approach a supervised segmentation network in terms of lesion overlap and tolerance-based surface agreement without being optimized using a voxel-wise segmentation loss, although a gap remains in anomaly score ranking and precise boundary localization.

paragraphs.en: Introducing subject-specific conditioning through ControlNet and deriving the anomaly map from a single CFG-based reconstruction (described in Sec. 3.3 ) did not result in consistent improvements across the evaluation metrics. With a lesion-recovery setting w = 0.8 w=0.8 , AP increased from 0.235 0.235 to 0.414 0.414 . However, Dice, HD, MASD, and NSD deteriorated. This result indicates that reducing the contribution of the subject condition can increase voxel-wise sensitivity to abnormal regions, while simultaneously introducing reconstruction differences that are spatially inconsistent with the lesion boundaries. Increasing the guidance scale to w = 7.5 w=7.5 , corresponding to the lesion-strengthening setting, partially improved Dice and the surface-distance metrics relative to w = 0.8 w=0.8 , but reduced AP to 0.332 0.332 and did not provide a consistent advantage over the DDPM baseline. These findings demonstrate the limited and inconsistent lesion sensitivity of anomaly maps derived from a single reconstructed image.

Importantly, because the discrepancy is computed directly from ϵ cond − ϵ uncond \boldsymbol{\epsilon}^{\mathrm{cond}}-\boldsymbol{\epsilon}^{\mathrm{uncond}} , its magnitude is independent of the CFG scale w w .

paragraphs.en: Fig. 4 illustrates the differences between reconstruction-based anomaly maps and our discrepancy-based approach in a representative case. DDPM alone produces substantial anatomical deviations from the input image, whereas ControlNet conditioning better preserves subject-specific anatomy. However, both DDPM and ControlNet-guided reconstruction with CFG = 0.8 =0.8 produce weak anomaly responses within the annotated lesion region. Increasing the guidance scale to CFG = 7.5 =7.5 produces higher anomaly scores overall, making the lesion region more noticeable. However, elevated scores also occur in surrounding non-lesion tissue, limiting spatial specificity. In contrast, our method produces more spatially confined responses that follow the annotated lesion distribution, although some lesion regions remain weakly highlighted and scattered responses persist outside the annotation. Mean filtering reduces isolated responses and produces a smoother map while retaining the main lesion-associated pattern. These observations complement the quantitative ablation results and illustrate the benefit of aggregating conditional–unconditional discrepancies across noise levels rather than relying on a final reconstruction residual.
paragraphs.zh: 图4在一个代表性案例中展示了基于重建的异常图与我们的基于差异的方法之间的区别。 单独使用DDPM会产生与输入图像明显偏离的解剖结构，而ControlNet条件控制则能更好地保留受试者特有的解剖结构。 然而，在CFG = 0.8 =0.8的条件下，DDPM和ControlNet引导的重建都在标注的病灶区域内产生较弱的异常响应。 将引导尺度提高到CFG = 7.5 =7.5后，整体异常分数更高，使病灶区域更加明显。 然而，周围的非病灶组织中也出现了较高的分数，限制了空间特异性。 相比之下，我们的方法产生的响应在空间上更加局限，并遵循标注的病灶分布，尽管一些病灶区域的响应仍然较弱，且标注区域之外仍存在零散的响应。 均值滤波减少了孤立的响应，生成了更平滑的图，同时保留了与病灶相关的主要模式。 这些观察结果补充了定量消融实验的结果，并说明了跨噪声水平聚合条件—无条件差异的益处，而非依赖最终的重建残差。

sents.en: Fig. 4 illustrates the differences between reconstruction-based anomaly maps and our discrepancy-based approach in a representative case.
sents.zh: 图4在一个代表性案例中展示了基于重建的异常图与我们的基于差异的方法之间的区别。

sents.en: DDPM alone produces substantial anatomical deviations from the input image, whereas ControlNet conditioning better preserves subject-specific anatomy.
sents.zh: 单独使用DDPM会产生与输入图像明显偏离的解剖结构，而ControlNet条件控制则能更好地保留受试者特有的解剖结构。

sents.en: However, both DDPM and ControlNet-guided reconstruction with CFG = 0.8 =0.8 produce weak anomaly responses within the annotated lesion region.
sents.zh: 然而，在CFG = 0.8 =0.8的条件下，DDPM和ControlNet引导的重建都在标注的病灶区域内产生较弱的异常响应。

sents.en: Increasing the guidance scale to CFG = 7.5 =7.5 produces higher anomaly scores overall, making the lesion region more noticeable.
sents.zh: 将引导尺度提高到CFG = 7.5 =7.5后，整体异常分数更高，使病灶区域更加明显。

sents.en: However, elevated scores also occur in surrounding non-lesion tissue, limiting spatial specificity.
sents.zh: 然而，周围的非病灶组织中也出现了较高的分数，限制了空间特异性。

sents.en: In contrast, our method produces more spatially confined responses that follow the annotated lesion distribution, although some lesion regions remain weakly highlighted and scattered responses persist outside the annotation.
sents.zh: 相比之下，我们的方法产生的响应在空间上更加局限，并遵循标注的病灶分布，尽管一些病灶区域的响应仍然较弱，且标注区域之外仍存在零散的响应。

The pathology-informed directional constraint was applied to all configurations.
paragraphs.zh: 表6比较了独立噪声水平评估、反向链累积，以及如第3.11节所述、用采样的前向噪声替代无条件预测的公式。 病理信息引导的方向性约束被应用于所有配置。

sents.en: Table 6 compares independent noise-level evaluation with reverse-chain accumulation and a formulation that replaces the unconditional prediction with the sampled forward noise, as described in Sec. 3.11 .
sents.zh: 表6比较了独立噪声水平评估、反向链累积，以及如第3.11节所述、用采样的前向噪声替代无条件预测的公式。

sents.en: The pathology-informed directional constraint was applied to all configurations.

paragraphs.en: Without mean filtering, independent evaluation outperformed reverse-chain accumulation (Eq. ( 43 )) in Dice ( 0.232 0.232 versus 0.070 0.070 ), AP ( 0.374 0.374 versus 0.031 0.031 ), and all surface metrics. This advantage persisted after mean filtering: reverse-chain formulation’s Dice remained at 0.070 0.070 and AP increased only to 0.036 0.036 , while HD and MASD worsened to 49.59 49.59 and 23.36 23.36 mm, respectively, and NSD decreased to 0.114 0.114 . The reduced performance of chain-dependent accumulation suggests that maintaining a continuous reverse trajectory is not advantageous for discrepancy-based anomaly localization. Because each state is generated from the preceding reverse estimate, stochastic perturbations and reconstruction errors introduced at earlier steps propagate through the remainder of the trajectory. Moreover, as the reverse process progressively modifies the image, subtle pathological information present in the original subject image may be attenuated, causing later discrepancy estimates to become less directly associated with the observed abnormality. In contrast, independently constructing the input at each noise level connects every comparison to the same observed image and prevents errors at one timestep from affecting discrepancy measurements at subsequent timesteps.
paragraphs.zh: 在不进行均值滤波的情况下，独立评估在 Dice（0.232 0.232 对 0.070 0.070）、AP（0.374 0.374 对 0.031 0.031）以及所有表面指标上均优于反向链累积（式 ( 43 )）。在均值滤波之后，这一优势依然存在：反向链公式的 Dice 保持在 0.070 0.070，AP 仅上升至 0.036 0.036，而 HD 和 MASD 分别恶化至 49.59 49.59 和 23.36 23.36 mm，NSD 则下降至 0.114 0.114。链式依赖累积性能的下降表明，维持连续的反向轨迹对于基于差异的异常定位并无益处。由于每个状态都是由前一个反向估计生成的，早期步骤中引入的随机扰动和重建误差会在轨迹的剩余部分中传播。此外，随着反向过程逐步修改图像，原始受试者图像中存在的细微病理信息可能被削弱，导致后续的差异估计与所观察到的异常之间的直接关联性降低。相比之下，在每个噪声水平下独立构建输入，使每次比较都连接到同一张观察到的图像，从而防止某个时间步的误差影响后续时间步的差异测量。

paragraphs.en: Replacing the unconditional prediction with the sampled forward noise (Eq. ( 44 )) produced the lowest performance across all metrics, with a Dice score of 0.045 0.045 , AP of 0.017 0.017 , HD of 75.30 75.30 mm, MASD of 52.69 52.69 mm, and NSD of 0.000 0.000 . The sampled forward noise is independent of the subject anatomy and does not encode the learned healthy-data distribution. Consequently, its difference from the conditional prediction primarily reflects noise-prediction error rather than deviation from a healthy reference. By comparison, the unconditional branch provides the denoising response favored by the learned healthy prior for the same noisy input.
paragraphs.zh: 用采样前向噪声（式 ( 44 )）替换无条件预测在所有指标上产生了最差的性能，Dice 得分为 0.045 0.045 ，AP 为 0.017 0.017 ，HD 为 75.30 75.30 mm，MASD 为 52.69 52.69 mm，NSD 为 0.000 0.000 。采样前向噪声与受试者解剖结构无关，且不编码所学到的健康数据分布。因此，它与条件预测之间的差异主要反映的是噪声预测误差，而非相对健康参考的偏离。相比之下，对于相同的带噪输入，无条件分支提供了由所学健康先验所偏好的去噪响应。

paragraphs.en: The results therefore support both central components of the proposed formulation: independent evaluation across noise levels prevents trajectory-dependent error propagation, while the learned unconditional prediction provides a meaningful healthy prior reference for detecting subject-specific pathological deviations.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，这些结果同时支持了所提出公式的两个核心组成部分：跨噪声水平的独立评估防止了依赖于轨迹的误差传播，而学习到的无条件预测为检测受试者特异性的病理偏差提供了有意义的健康先验参考。

paragraphs.en: We first examined whether the direction of the conditional–unconditional discrepancy was consistent with the expected reduction in ADC associated with acute HIE lesions. Table 7 summarizes the discrepancy d t ​ ( i ) = ϵ t , i cond − ϵ t , i uncond d_{t}(i)=\epsilon^{\mathrm{cond}}_{t,i}-\epsilon^{\mathrm{uncond}}_{t,i} within lesion and background voxels across the selected noise levels. Through the positive scaling relationship established in the Methods Sec. 3.4 , positive value is equivalent to the healthy-prior response predicting a higher ADC value than the subject-conditioned response. Lesion voxels exhibited a positive discrepancy at 88.6 % 88.6\% of the evaluated voxel–timestep pairs, compared with 53.0 % 53.0\% in the background. The mean positive discrepancy was 0.266 in lesion versus 0.155 in background and the mean negative discrepancy was -0.107 and − 0.176 -0.176 respectively. These observations indicate that lesion voxels exhibit not only larger conditional–unconditional differences but also a systematic shift in the direction expected for reduced ADC. In contrast, background discrepancies nearly symmetrically occur in both directions.

paragraphs.en: Table 8 further evaluates whether incorporating this directional prior improves anomaly localization with and without mean filtering. Without mean filtering, the directional constraint significantly increased Dice from 0.115 0.115 to 0.232 0.232 (absolute gain of 0.117 0.117 ; p < 0.001 p<0.001 , n = 44 n=44 ). AP increased from 0.222 0.222 to 0.374 0.374 , while HD decreased from 33.99 33.99 to 29.29 29.29 mm, MASD decreased from 15.18 15.18 to 12.62 12.62 mm, and NSD increased from 0.189 0.189 to 0.284 0.284 . The improvement persisted when both formulations used mean filtering with a kernel size of 5 5 . Adding the directional constraint increased Dice from 0.209 0.209 to 0.283 0.283 (absolute gain of 0.074 0.074 ; p < 0.001 p<0.001 , n = 44 n=44 ). HD decreased from 30.16 30.16 to 25.45 25.45 mm, MASD decreased from 11.48 11.48 to 9.40 9.40 mm, and NSD increased from 0.266 0.266 to 0.355 0.355 , alongside a smaller increase in AP from 0.490 0.490 to 0.505 0.505 . Thus, the directional constraint improved all evaluated metrics both with and without mean filtering.

paragraphs.en: To evaluate whether the low-ADC directional prior also benefits existing methods, we applied it to the final reconstruction residuals of representative unsupervised baselines, retaining only deviations consistent with lower ADC in the observed image than in the reconstruction. This output-level modification left the original models and reconstruction procedures unchanged (Table 9 ). Compared with their original results in Table 1 , directional filtering increased Dice from 0.159 0.159 to 0.172 0.172 for DAE, from 0.085 0.085 to 0.104 0.104 for AutoDDPM, and from 0.166 0.166 to 0.173 0.173 for MAD-AD, while pDDPM remained unchanged at the reported precision ( 0.121 0.121 ). Among these modified baselines, MAD-AD achieved the highest Dice ( 0.173 0.173 ) and NSD ( 0.226 0.226 ) and the lowest MASD ( 11.16 11.16 mm), whereas DAE achieved the highest AP ( 0.680 0.680 ) and the lowest HD ( 25.13 25.13 mm).
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估低ADC方向先验是否也能使现有方法受益，我们将其应用于代表性无监督基线方法的最终重建残差，仅保留观测图像中ADC低于重建图像的偏差。 这种输出层面的修改使原有模型和重建过程保持不变（表9）。 与表1中的原始结果相比，方向滤波使DAE的Dice从0.159提升到0.172，AutoDDPM从0.085提升到0.104，MAD-AD从0.166提升到0.173，而pDDPM在报告精度下保持不变（0.121）。 在这些修改后的基线方法中，MAD-AD取得了最高的Dice（0.173）和NSD（0.226）以及最低的MASD（11.16 mm），而DAE取得了最高的AP（0.680）和最低的HD（25.13 mm）。

paragraphs.en: Our method with mean filtering achieved a Dice score of 0.283 0.283 , significantly exceeding each low-ADC direction filtered baseline (all p < 0.001 p<0.001 , n = 44 n=44 ). It also achieved a lower MASD ( 9.40 9.40 mm) and higher NSD ( 0.355 0.355 ) than all modified baselines. Its HD ( 25.45 25.45 mm) was slightly higher than that of DAE, while its AP ( 0.505 0.505 ) exceeded those of AutoDDPM, pDDPM, and MAD-AD but remained below DAE. Thus, our model performance advantage persisted when the same pathological direction was incorporated into baseline outputs.

paragraphs.en: The proposed ADC-only framework demonstrated strong overall performance for unsupervised HIE lesion localization. However, the improvement was not uniform across all evaluation criteria and this behavior reflects the different properties measured by these metrics. AP evaluates the ranking of continuous anomaly scores across lesion and background voxels without selecting a single operating threshold, whereas Dice and the surface metrics evaluate the geometry of the resulting binary segmentation. The comparatively strong Dice and surface performance of our method therefore suggests improved spatial localization, while its lower AP indicates that the continuous anomaly scores remain imperfectly calibrated and that some background voxels still receive scores overlapping those of lesion voxels. Improving cross-subject score calibration and suppressing non-pathological background responses remain important directions for further investigation.
paragraphs.zh: 所提出的仅用ADC的框架在无监督HIE病灶定位中展现出较强的整体性能。 然而，这种提升在所有评估指标上并不一致，这一现象反映了这些指标所衡量的不同属性。 AP评估的是病灶体素与背景体素之间连续异常分数的排序，无需选取单一的操作阈值，而Dice和表面指标评估的是所得二值分割的几何特性。 因此，我们方法相对较强的Dice和表面指标表现表明其空间定位有所改善，而其较低的AP则表明连续异常分数的校准仍不完善，部分背景体素获得的分数仍与病灶体素的分数存在重叠。 改善跨被试的分数校准并抑制非病理性背景响应仍是进一步研究的重要方向。

paragraphs.en: The comparison with supervised ADC-only models also demonstrates the potential of learning from healthy-image structure rather than directly optimizing voxel-wise lesion-mask prediction. Competitive performance in selected spatial metrics suggests that a learned healthy prior, combined with subject conditioning and pathological directionality, can provide informative localization cues without voxel-wise lesion supervision in the training objective. This is particularly relevant when available annotations do not adequately represent the diversity of lesion appearances. The findings support healthy-prior modeling as a complementary route to quantitative HIE lesion assessment.
paragraphs.zh: 与仅有监督的 ADC 模型的对比也表明，学习健康影像结构而非直接优化体素级病灶掩码预测具有潜力。 在部分空间指标上的有竞争力表现表明，学习到的健康先验结合受试者条件化与病理方向性，可以在训练目标中没有体素级病灶监督的情况下提供有信息量的定位线索。 当可用的标注不足以代表病灶表现的多样性时，这一点尤为相关。 这些发现支持将健康先验建模作为定量评估 HIE 病灶的一种互补途径。

paragraphs.en: The lesion-burden analysis indicates that the primary limitation of the proposed method is the detection of subjects with small lesion burdens. Larger HIE abnormalities affect more voxels and are more likely to produce spatially coherent, persistent discrepancies across multiple diffusion noise levels. In contrast, small or low-contrast lesions generate weaker and more localized responses that can be difficult to distinguish from normal anatomical variability, registration differences, and acquisition noise. Mean filtering partially mitigated this limitation by suppressing isolated high-response voxels and reinforcing discrepancies supported by neighboring voxels, resulting in the largest improvements for the small- and medium- burden groups. For subjects with large lesions, however, the anomaly signal was already spatially coherent, leaving less noise for the filter to remove. Additional smoothing could also blur lesion boundaries or extend responses into adjacent healthy tissue, explaining the minimal Dice improvement and the reduction in NSD observed in this group.
paragraphs.zh: 病灶负荷分析表明，所提方法的主要局限在于对小病灶负荷受试者的检测。 较大的缺氧缺血性脑病（HIE）异常会波及更多体素，更可能在多个扩散噪声水平上产生空间上连贯且持续的差异。 相比之下，小病灶或低对比度病灶产生的响应较弱且更为局部化，难以与正常的解剖变异、配准差异以及采集噪声区分开来。 均值滤波通过抑制孤立的高响应体素并强化由邻近体素支持的差异，部分缓解了这一局限，使小病灶负荷组和中病灶负荷组获得了最大的改善。 然而，对于具有大病灶的受试者，异常信号本身已具有空间连贯性，留给滤波器去除的噪声较少。 额外的平滑还可能模糊病灶边界或将响应扩展到相邻的健康组织，这解释了该组中 Dice 提升有限以及 NSD 下降的现象。

paragraphs.en: The relatively large inter-subject standard deviations further indicate heterogeneous performance across the test cohort. Such variability may reflect differences in lesion burden, anatomical distribution, scan timing, and acquisition characteristics. Future studies should therefore evaluate performance after stratification by lesion burden, injury pattern, scanner field strength, and postnatal age at MRI, in addition to validating the method in independent multi-center cohorts.
paragraphs.zh: 受试者间标准差相对较大，进一步表明测试队列内的表现存在异质性。 这种变异性可能反映了病灶负荷、解剖分布、扫描时机以及采集特征方面的差异。 因此，未来的研究应在按病灶负荷、损伤模式、扫描仪磁场强度和MRI时出生后年龄进行分层后评估性能，并在独立的多中心队列中验证该方法。

paragraphs.en: Most diffusion-based anomaly-detection methods identify abnormalities by comparing an observed image with its final pseudo-healthy reconstruction. Although intuitive, this formulation compresses the entire reverse diffusion trajectory into a single terminal image. Subtle pathological information expressed during intermediate denoising steps may therefore be attenuated or lost before the final reconstruction is obtained. Moreover, the reconstruction difference reflects not only lesion restoration but also stochastic sampling variation, incomplete lesion removal, and unintended modification of subject-specific healthy anatomy. The latter can generate false-positive responses even when the reconstructed image appears globally plausible.
paragraphs.zh: 大多数基于扩散的异常检测方法通过将观测图像与其最终的伪健康重建进行比较来识别异常。 尽管直观，这种表述将整个反向扩散轨迹压缩为单一的终端图像。 因此，在中间去噪步骤中表达的细微病理信息可能在获得最终重建之前被衰减或丢失。 此外，重建差异不仅反映了病灶恢复，还反映了随机采样变异、病灶去除不完全以及对个体特异性健康解剖结构的不当修改。 即使重建图像在整体上看似合理，后者也可能产生假阳性响应。

paragraphs.en: Our CFG reconstruction experiments illustrate these limitations. Reducing the guidance scale to w = 0.8 w=0.8 encouraged stronger restoration toward the learned healthy distribution and increased AP relative to the DDPM baseline, but substantially degraded Dice and the surface-distance metrics. This suggests that weaker subject conditioning increased sensitivity to image differences while also introducing spatial changes unrelated to the true lesion. Conversely, increasing the guidance scale to w = 7.5 w=7.5 preserved and strengthened subject-specific information but did not produce consistently accurate anomaly localization.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的CFG重建实验说明了这些局限性。 将引导尺度降低到 w = 0.8 w=0.8 促使重建结果更强地恢复到所学习的健康分布，并使AP相对于DDPM基线有所提升，但显著降低了Dice和表面距离指标。 这表明较弱的受试者条件化增加了对图像差异的敏感性，同时也引入了与真实病变无关的空间变化。 相反，将引导尺度提高到 w = 7.5 w=7.5 保留并强化了受试者特定的信息，但并未产生始终准确的异常定位。

paragraphs.en: Our proposed method instead measures the conditional–unconditional difference directly in the intermediate noise-prediction space. Since both predictions are evaluated from the same noisy image 𝐱 t \mathbf{x}_{t} , the comparison controls for the common forward corruption and isolates the change in the denoising response induced by the subject-specific condition. The unconditional branch represents the response favored by the learned healthy prior, and the conditional branch retains information from the observed subject. Therefore, their difference provides a more direct measure of how the observed anatomy modifies the healthy denoising field than a comparison between two final reconstructed images. The substantially higher Dice obtained using multi noise-level discrepancy accumulation than using either CFG-based reconstruction supports the utility of extracting anomaly evidence before it is compressed into the final reconstruction.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出的方法则直接在中间噪声预测空间中度量条件与无条件之间的差异。 由于两个预测都是基于同一张含噪图像 𝐱 t \mathbf{x}_{t} 计算的，这一比较控制了共同的前向退化，从而分离出由受试者特定条件引起的去噪响应变化。 无条件分支代表由学习到的健康先验所偏好的响应，而条件分支保留了来自被观测受试者的信息。 因此，与比较两张最终重建图像相比，二者的差异能更直接地度量被观测解剖结构如何修改健康的去噪场。 使用多噪声水平差异累积所获得的 Dice 显著高于使用任一基于 CFG 的重建，这支持了在异常证据被压缩进最终重建之前提取该证据的实用性。

sents.en: The unconditional branch represents the response favored by the learned healthy prior, and the conditional branch retains information from the observed subject.
sents.zh: 无条件分支代表由学习到的健康先验所偏好的响应，而条件分支保留了来自被观测受试者的信息。

sents.en: Therefore, their difference provides a more direct measure of how the observed anatomy modifies the healthy denoising field than a comparison between two final reconstructed images.
sents.zh: 因此，与比较两张最终重建图像相比，二者的差异能更直接地度量被观测解剖结构如何修改健康的去噪场。

sents.en: The substantially higher Dice obtained using multi noise-level discrepancy accumulation than using either CFG-based reconstruction supports the utility of extracting anomaly evidence before it is compressed into the final reconstruction.
sents.zh: 使用多噪声水平差异累积所获得的 Dice 显著高于使用任一基于 CFG 的重建，这支持了在异常证据被压缩进最终重建之前提取该证据的实用性。

paragraphs.en: Evaluating each noise level independently provides an additional advantage over following a single reverse chain. In the chain-dependent formulation, each state inherits stochastic variation and reconstruction error from all preceding transitions, and progressive restoration may attenuate subtle pathological signals before they contribute to later discrepancy estimates. In contrast, independently sampling 𝐱 t \mathbf{x}_{t} from the observed image connects every comparison to the same subject and prevents errors at one noise level from propagating to another. Accumulation across the selected intermediate noise levels emphasizes discrepancies that persist under different corruption strengths rather than relying on a single potentially unstable observation. Intermediate noise levels are particularly useful because they partially suppress the observed lesion while retaining sufficient subject-specific anatomical information. At substantially higher noise levels, the anatomical condition may become weak, whereas near-clean inputs may provide insufficient separation between the two branch responses.
paragraphs.zh: 与遵循单一反向链相比，独立评估每个噪声水平具有额外优势。 在链依赖的表述中，每个状态会继承之前所有转移带来的随机波动和重建误差，渐进式的恢复可能在细微病理信号参与后续差异估计之前就将其削弱。 相比之下，从观测图像独立采样 𝐱 t \mathbf{x}_{t} 能使每次比较都对应同一个受试对象，并防止某一噪声水平处的误差传播到另一水平。 跨选定中间噪声水平的累积强调的是在不同损坏强度下持续存在的差异，而非依赖单次可能不稳定的观测。 中间噪声水平尤为有用，因为它们部分抑制观测到的病灶，同时保留足够的受试者特异性解剖信息。 在明显更高的噪声水平下，解剖条件可能变得微弱，而接近干净的输入则可能无法在两个分支的响应之间提供足够的区分度。

paragraphs.en: A central feature of the proposed framework is that it does not treat all conditional–unconditional discrepancies as equally suggestive of pathology. Acute HIE is commonly associated with cytotoxic edema, restricted diffusion, and reduced ADC values ( Forbes et al., 2000 ; Bobba et al., 2023 ; Onda et al., 2024 ) . We therefore retain discrepancy components for which the healthy-prior response predicts a higher ADC value than the patient-conditioned response. This constraint provides a clinically motivated direction to the anomaly score and suppresses deviations that are inconsistent with the expected low-ADC appearance of acute HIE. In contrast to an unsigned reconstruction residual, the resulting score can consequently be interpreted as evidence that the observed tissue deviates from the learned healthy distribution in a direction consistent with water diffusion restriction.
paragraphs.zh: 所提出框架的一个核心特点是，它并不将所有的条件-无条件差异同等视为病理的提示。 急性缺氧缺血性脑病（HIE）通常与细胞毒性水肿、弥散受限以及ADC值降低相关（ Forbes et al., 2000 ; Bobba et al., 2023 ; Onda et al., 2024 ）。 因此，我们保留那些健康先验响应预测的ADC值高于患者条件响应的差异分量。 这一约束为异常评分提供了具有临床依据的方向性，并抑制与急性HIE预期低ADC表现不一致的偏差。 因此，与无符号的重建残差不同，所得评分可以被解释为以下证据：观测组织在符合水弥散受限的方向上偏离了所学习的健康分布。

sents.zh: 所提出框架的一个核心特点是，它并不将所有的条件-无条件差异同等视为病理的提示。

paragraphs.en: The quantitative analysis on the distribution of discrepancy supports this assumption. At the selected noise levels, the expected positive discrepancy occurred more frequently in annotated lesion voxels than in background voxels. Lesion voxels also exhibited a substantially larger positive discrepancy. Consistent with these observations, incorporating the pathology-informed sign constraint improved lesion localization relative to the corresponding unsigned formulation. These findings demonstrate that the selected direction is statistically associated with annotated HIE abnormalities and is more specific than using unsigned discrepancy magnitude alone.
paragraphs.zh: 关于差异分布的定量分析支持了这一假设。 在选定的噪声水平下，预期的正向差异在标注的病灶体素中出现的频率高于背景体素。 病灶体素还表现出明显更大的正向差异。 与这些观察结果一致，引入病理引导的符号约束相较于对应的无符号形式提升了病灶定位效果。 这些发现表明，所选方向在统计上与标注的 HIE 异常相关，并且比仅使用无符号差异幅值更具特异性。

sents.en: The quantitative analysis on the distribution of discrepancy supports this assumption.
sents.zh: 关于差异分布的定量分析支持了这一假设。

sents.zh: 在选定的噪声水平下，预期的正向差异在标注的病灶体素中出现的频率高于背景体素。

paragraphs.en: An additional advantage of the proposed formulation is that the pathological prior is incorporated directly into the intermediate diffusion discrepancy, rather than being applied only to a completed reconstruction-derived anomaly map. Most conventional reconstruction-based methods define direction-agnostic anomaly evidence using an absolute or squared residual between the observed image and its pseudo-healthy reconstruction. Although a low-ADC directional constraint can be applied to the signed reconstruction residual, such output-level filtering is performed only after the reconstruction process has mixed pathological deviations with reconstruction blur, anatomical mismatch, and stochastic generation errors. It can remove some directionally inconsistent responses, but it cannot recover pathological evidence that was attenuated during reconstruction or determine whether the final residual was supported consistently across the diffusion trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 所提建模方式的另一个优势是，病理先验被直接融入到中间扩散差异中，而不是仅应用于由完整重建导出的异常图上。 大多数传统的基于重建的方法使用观测图像与其伪健康重建之间的绝对残差或平方残差来定义方向无关的异常证据。 虽然可以对带符号的重建残差施加低ADC方向约束，但这种输出层面的过滤仅在重建过程将病理偏差与重建模糊、解剖结构不匹配以及随机生成误差混合之后才进行。 它可以去除一些方向不一致的响应，但无法恢复在重建过程中被削弱的病理证据，也无法判断最终残差是否在整个扩散轨迹中得到一致的支持。

paragraphs.en: The comparative experiments support this distinction. Applying the same low-ADC directional rule as post-processing to conventional anomaly-detection outputs improved their localization performance, indicating that the pathological prior is useful even at the output level. However, these gains were smaller than those obtained when the directional constraint was integrated into the multi noise-level discrepancy formulation. This difference suggests that biological knowledge is more effective when intermediate denoising responses contribute to the anomaly score, rather than being used only to reject candidates after reconstruction.
paragraphs.zh: 对比实验支持了这一区分。 将相同的低ADC方向性规则作为后处理应用于传统异常检测的输出，提升了其定位性能，表明该病理先验即使在输出层面也是有用的。 然而，这些增益小于将方向性约束融入多噪声级差异公式时所获得的增益。 这一差异表明，当中间去噪响应参与异常评分的计算时，生物学知识更为有效，而不仅仅用于在重建之后剔除候选结果。

sents.en: The comparative experiments support this distinction.
sents.zh: 对比实验支持了这一区分。

paragraphs.en: False-positive responses in regions with low ADC or interhemispheric intensity asymmetry are consistent with the intended behavior of the directional constraint, but also highlight its limited pathological specificity. The constraint selects voxels with deviations in the expected direction of ADC reduction, but directional agreement alone is insufficient to attribute these deviations to HIE-related injury. Incorporating regional anatomical context and spatially adaptive filtering may help distinguish lesion-associated responses from non-pathological variability.
paragraphs.zh: 在低ADC区域或半球间强度不对称区域出现的假阳性反应符合方向性约束的预期行为，但也凸显了其病理特异性有限。 该约束选择ADC沿预期降低方向出现偏差的体素，但仅有方向上的一致性不足以将这些偏差归因于HIE相关损伤。 结合区域解剖背景和空间自适应滤波可能有助于区分病灶相关反应与非病理性变异。

paragraphs.en: The population Z Z -map analysis demonstrates that voxel-wise normative information can substantially improve lesion localization when an appropriate reference population and accurate spatial correspondence are available. However, this improvement introduces requirements that may limit generalizability in routine clinical settings. Constructing a meaningful ADC Z Z -map requires spatially resolved estimates of the healthy population mean and standard deviation. These reference statistics may vary with postmenstrual age, scanner vendor, magnetic field strength, diffusion acquisition protocol, reconstruction procedure, and preprocessing pipeline. This issue is particularly relevant in neonatal imaging because brain structure and diffusion properties change rapidly during early development.
paragraphs.zh: 群体 Z Z 图分析表明，当拥有合适的参考群体和准确的空间对应关系时，体素级别的常模信息可以显著改善病灶定位。 然而，这一改进引入了一些可能限制其在常规临床环境中推广性的要求。 构建有意义的 ADC Z Z 图需要空间分辨的健康人群均值和标准差估计值。 这些参考统计量可能随月经后年龄、扫描仪厂商、磁场强度、扩散采集协议、重建流程和预处理流程而变化。 这一问题在新生儿成像中尤为相关，因为大脑结构和扩散特性在早期发育过程中变化迅速。

sents.en: The population Z Z -map analysis demonstrates that voxel-wise normative information can substantially improve lesion localization when an appropriate reference population and accurate spatial correspondence are available.
sents.zh: 群体 Z Z 图分析表明，当拥有合适的参考群体和准确的空间对应关系时，体素级别的常模信息可以显著改善病灶定位。

sents.en: However, this improvement introduces requirements that may limit generalizability in routine clinical settings.
sents.zh: 然而，这一改进引入了一些可能限制其在常规临床环境中推广性的要求。

sents.en: Constructing a meaningful ADC Z Z -map requires spatially resolved estimates of the healthy population mean and standard deviation.
sents.zh: 构建有意义的 ADC Z Z 图需要空间分辨的健康人群均值和标准差估计值。

sents.en: These reference statistics may vary with postmenstrual age, scanner vendor, magnetic field strength, diffusion acquisition protocol, reconstruction procedure, and preprocessing pipeline.
sents.zh: 这些参考统计量可能随月经后年龄、扫描仪厂商、磁场强度、扩散采集协议、重建流程和预处理流程而变化。

sents.en: This issue is particularly relevant in neonatal imaging because brain structure and diffusion properties change rapidly during early development.
sents.zh: 这一问题在新生儿成像中尤为相关，因为大脑结构和扩散特性在早期发育过程中变化迅速。

paragraphs.en: Voxel-wise Z Z -maps also depend on accurate alignment between the observed scan and the normative template. Errors in nonlinear registration may generate artificial deviations near tissue boundaries, ventricles, and rapidly developing anatomical structures. Consequently, a Z Z -map derived from one cohort may not transfer reliably to a population with different demographics, acquisition characteristics, or spatial normalization quality. Site-specific recalibration or construction of a new normative reference may therefore be required before deployment.
paragraphs.zh: 体素级的 Z Z 图还依赖于观测扫描与常模模板之间的精确对齐。 非线性配准的误差可能会在组织边界、脑室以及快速发育的解剖结构附近产生人为的偏差。 因此，由某一队列导出的 Z Z 图可能无法可靠地迁移到人口统计学特征、采集参数或空间标准化质量不同的人群。 因此，在部署之前可能需要进行针对站点的重新校准或构建新的常模参考。

sents.en: Voxel-wise Z Z -maps also depend on accurate alignment between the observed scan and the normative template.
sents.zh: 体素级的 Z Z 图还依赖于观测扫描与常模模板之间的精确对齐。

sents.en: Errors in nonlinear registration may generate artificial deviations near tissue boundaries, ventricles, and rapidly developing anatomical structures.
sents.zh: 非线性配准的误差可能会在组织边界、脑室以及快速发育的解剖结构附近产生人为的偏差。

sents.en: Consequently, a Z Z -map derived from one cohort may not transfer reliably to a population with different demographics, acquisition characteristics, or spatial normalization quality.
sents.zh: 因此，由某一队列导出的 Z Z 图可能无法可靠地迁移到人口统计学特征、采集参数或空间标准化质量不同的人群。

sents.en: Site-specific recalibration or construction of a new normative reference may therefore be required before deployment.
sents.zh: 因此，在部署之前可能需要进行针对站点的重新校准或构建新的常模参考。

paragraphs.en: For these reasons, we consider the Z Z -map refinement an optional population-reference assisted extension rather than the principal contribution of the proposed framework. The primary ADC-only model does not require population-level voxel-wise means and standard deviations or the precise nonlinear normalization required to construct a normative Z Z -map. Although its localization performance is lower than that of the Z Z -map assisted configuration, it reduces dependence on cohort-specific reference data and may therefore offer greater portability across clinical populations and acquisition settings. Future work should evaluate whether normative harmonization, age-conditioned reference models, or registration-robust population representations can retain the localization benefit of Z Z -scores while improving cross-cohort generalizability.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这些原因，我们认为 Z Z 图细化是一种可选的、借助人群参考的扩展，而非所提框架的主要贡献。 仅使用 ADC 的主模型不需要人群水平的体素均值和标准差，也不需要构建规范 Z Z 图所需的精确非线性归一化。 尽管其定位性能低于 Z Z 图辅助配置，但它降低了对队列特定参考数据的依赖，因此在临床人群和采集环境之间可能具有更好的可移植性。 未来的工作应评估规范性协调、按年龄条件构建的参考模型或配准稳健的人群表征，能否在保留 Z 分数定位优势的同时提升跨队列的泛化能力。

sents.en: For these reasons, we consider the Z Z -map refinement an optional population-reference assisted extension rather than the principal contribution of the proposed framework.
sents.zh: 基于这些原因，我们认为 Z Z 图细化是一种可选的、借助人群参考的扩展，而非所提框架的主要贡献。

sents.en: The primary ADC-only model does not require population-level voxel-wise means and standard deviations or the precise nonlinear normalization required to construct a normative Z Z -map.

sents.zh: 尽管其定位性能低于 Z Z 图辅助配置，但它降低了对队列特定参考数据的依赖，因此在临床人群和采集环境之间可能具有更好的可移植性。

sents.en: Future work should evaluate whether normative harmonization, age-conditioned reference models, or registration-robust population representations can retain the localization benefit of Z Z -scores while improving cross-cohort generalizability.
sents.zh: 未来的工作应评估规范性协调、按年龄条件构建的参考模型或配准稳健的人群表征，能否在保留 Z 分数定位优势的同时提升跨队列的泛化能力。

paragraphs.en: Several limitations should be considered when interpreting the present findings. First, although lesion annotations were not used as voxel-wise training targets, they were used to exclude lesion-containing slices when constructing the healthy training subset. The proposed training procedure is therefore annotation-free at the voxel-wise training stage but is not entirely independent of annotations. Moreover, unannotated slices from an HIE-affected subject may still contain subtle or diffuse abnormalities that were not included in the reference mask, potentially contaminating the learned healthy distribution. Future studies should train the framework using an independently acquired cohort of clinically healthy neonates with ADC imaging. This would eliminate the need for lesion mask-based slice selection and permit a more direct evaluation of fully annotation-independent training.
paragraphs.zh: 在解释本研究结果时应考虑若干局限性。 首先，虽然病灶标注并未被用作体素级别的训练目标，但在构建健康训练子集时，它们被用于排除包含病灶的切片。 因此，所提出的训练流程在体素级别的训练阶段是无标注的，但并非完全独立于标注。 此外，来自缺氧缺血性脑病（HIE）受试者的未标注切片可能仍包含未纳入参考掩膜的细微或弥漫性异常，从而可能污染所学习的健康分布。 未来的研究应使用独立获取的、带 ADC 成像的临床健康新生儿队列来训练该框架。 这将消除基于病灶掩膜进行切片选择的需求，并能更直接地评估完全独立于标注的训练。

sents.zh: 未来的研究应使用独立获取的、带 ADC 成像的临床健康新生儿队列来训练该框架。
